text:
claire_csm: FYI — MeridianBio tokens/day down ~90% over last 7 days. Renewal 11 days out. Product lead left; procurement asked for a competitor pilot. Need quick triage and retention play.

health-bot: Alert: customer=MeridianBio, metric=tokens_7d, change=-90%, seats=9->2, error_rate=0.8%->6.5%, recent_deploy=2026-03-12. Link: https://redwood.app/customers/meridianbio/health

dan_sales: I was on procurement thread — they got a trial offer from EchoAI for lower price. They said "responses dropped off midweek". I'll handle commercial outreach.

yuki_eng: Quick triage items I can run: per-key usage, error histogram, instance OOMs. If we can get 1-2 failing request ids that will speed root cause.

maya_ops: Billing note: noticed admin seats removed by automated SSO job on 2026-03-16; could explain lost champions. Also top api_key went inactive 3/17.

health-bot: Query summary (14d): errors=502(60%), 429(25%), 401(15%). Peak 502s 2026-03-17 01:00-03:00 UTC. Top_key last active 2026-03-17.

claire_csm: Scheduling 20m sync with interim PM now to collect failing ids and confirm key rotation or endpoint changes.

dan_sales: Draft commercial counter: 10-day microburst (3x baseline) + 1-hr pairing + performance report. Need finance approval for credits > $4k. Tagging @finance.

yuki_eng: On call — PM provided two ids: req_20260317_p9 and req_20260317_q2. Triage: p9 -> 502 router OOM due to payload spike; q2 -> 401 old key. Root cause: large batch rollout + partial key rotation.

maya_ops: Immediate mitigations applied: restored admin seats, whitelisted PM IP for pairing, temporary per-key burst x3 for confirmed new key, and server-side throttle for payloads >5k tokens with clear error message.

dan_sales: Sent written offer (email): 10-day microburst at 3x, 1-hr pairing, and post-trial perf metrics. Asked for acceptance within 24h.

health-bot: Snapshot 6h later: tokens/day recovered to 74% baseline after key reconciliation and quota bump; error rate down to 1.1%. Recommend 48h monitor and QBR scheduling.

claire_csm: Added renewal-risk tag, created playbook with owners/due dates, scheduled 3-day check-in and QBR. Will update thread as customer accepts the offer.
